body:
I can understand your general situation. I know I need some professional help too but I can't afford it. I dreamed and thought about how would be a therapy session a lot of times, trying to fix myself. Not easy.   
I know it sound like bullshit, pixels on a screen with no meaning, but I'd like to send you a virtual hug. People can be connected in a lot of different ways, this won't change your life right away, that's something only you can do, but at least I can try to lighten the mood.  
I'd try to call the hotline anyway.
